summary.business_type: Local Service (hybrid): commercial and office cleaning company, one office at 243 Queen St W, Toronto, serving Toronto and 9 GTA cities
data_limits: No CrUX field data (PageSpeed Insights API quota exhausted, no Google API credentials); performance is Lighthouse 12.8 lab data from the audit container, one run per page
No Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile or backlink API access; Search Console figures quoted come from the repository docs
No DataForSEO: no local-pack, geo-grid or live AI answer sampling
WebSearch results used for SERP analysis were not Google's own results page (no local pack, PAA or AI Overview visible)
top_findings: Mobile homepage Lighthouse performance 51: Google tag scripts (gtm.js 157 KB + gtag.js 194 KB) block the main thread for 1,345 ms and inflate the simulated LCP to 6.8 s (observed LCP 1.5 s)
No named person anywhere on the site: no owner, account executive or author; all 25 posts are credited to the organization and the About page names nobody
The office cleaning cost guide (title '2026 Pricing Guide') gives only figures it labels hypothetical, so it fails the cost intent and gives AI engines nothing to quote

Third-party proof is thin: 7 Google reviews (4 of them 5-6 years old), no case study published, all imagery stock, no citations found under the current NAP on YellowPages or BBB; social profile URLs still carry the former name
Three URLs compete for 'commercial cleaning Toronto' (homepage, /services/commercial-cleaning/, /locations/toronto-downtown/), reinforced by sitewide footer anchors
quick_wins: Defer the GTM loader to first interaction or idle, with tel:/form-focus triggers (src/components/GoogleTagManager.astro)
Stop the italic Open Sans face loading on the homepage (.tes-name normal; scope the face to post pages): -50 KB in the LCP window
Fix the sitewide footer anchors in src/data/site.ts: 'Toronto' -> 'Downtown Toronto', repoint or remove 'Toronto & GTA', make Richmond Hill and Scarborough plain text until pages exist
Retitle the cost guide ('How Office Cleaning Is Priced in Toronto') or publish real price bands from recent proposals
Add the brand suffix to the 22 bare blog titles, trim 8 meta descriptions over 160 chars and the 64-char commercial title
Remove the dead WebSite SearchAction (points at a noindex page); drop the trailing period in '243 Queen St W.' so the address string matches the Google listing
Fix the http:// link on /privacy/, add charset=utf-8 to the HTML Content-Type header, add the three 2026 guides to llms.txt

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 92 crawled URLs return 200; no broken internal links; one H1, lang=en-CA, viewport and self-canonical on every indexable page
http->https, apex->www and slashless->slashed are all 301; /index.html 307; legacy WordPress paths (wp-login, xmlrpc, feed, sitemap_index.xml) are 404 or 301 correctly; real 404 page with noindex
Static HTML: content, JSON-LD and hero image present without JavaScript; Brotli on HTML and assets; /_astro/* immutable 1 year; HTML at Cloudflare edge
Security headers on every response: HSTS 1y, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy, CSP (report-only)
Sitemaps valid, split by type, 57/57 URLs 200 + indexable + self-canonical; no noindex URL listed; lastmod from git history, not build time

findings.title: CSP is report-only with unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval
findings.description: content-security-policy-report-only on every response; Lighthouse csp-xss reports no enforced CSP. Hardening, not a ranking factor.
findings.recommendation: Enforce the non-script directives now (frame-ancestors, object-src, base-uri, form-action) in public/_headers; drop unsafe-eval after the GTM container is audited.

findings.title: robots.txt Content-Signal lines flagged by Lighthouse as unknown directives
findings.description: Lighthouse SEO scores 92 on every page because of the two Content-Signal lines. Googlebot ignores unknown fields; crawl is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: keep (and document the expected Lighthouse flag) or remove, since allow-all is already the default.

findings.title: 17 sitemap lastmod values share one template-commit timestamp
findings.description: services/*, industries/* and locations/* all show 2026-10-31T14:11:02Z from a shared quote-form commit, not a content change.
findings.recommendation: Exclude shared templates (OfferPage.astro, locations/[slug].astro) from the date sources in src/lib/sitemap-lastmod.mjs; add a CI check that every <url> has a <lastmod>.

findings.title: Plain http:// internal link on /privacy/
findings.description: Only http internal link in the crawl; adds a redirect hop and created a duplicate crawl entry.
findings.recommendation: Change the href to https://www.evergreencleaningservice.ca/ in the privacy page source.

findings.title: HTML Content-Type has no charset
findings.description: content-type: text/html with no charset; <meta charset> saves browsers, but naive fetchers decode em dashes as mojibake.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8' for /* in public/_headers (and text/plain; charset=utf-8 for /llms.txt).

findings.title: Two-hop redirect for http/apex URLs without trailing slash
findings.description: http://evergreencleaningservice.ca/about-us -> https://www.../about-us -> /about-us/.
findings.recommendation: Append the slash in the Cloudflare host redirect rule, or accept.

findings.title: Third-party cookie from DoubleClick (best-practices 79)
findings.description: test_cookie set by the Google Ads view-through tag.
findings.recommendation: Gate remarketing behind consent mode or disable view-through if unused; otherwise accept.

findings.title: 25 noindex tag/category archives linked from every post
findings.description: follow,noindex archives receive internal links; crawl budget is not a concern at 92 URLs.
findings.recommendation: No change needed.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Service and industry pages are substantive (667-2,435 words), specific about scope, scheduling and limits, with FAQ blocks; readability Flesch ~57-64, grade 8-9
Location pages are not city-swaps in the body: 2-12% verbatim overlap, real districts, corridors and drive times, honest 'no office in X' statements
Blog update dates match real rewrites in git; no templated metadata; plugin content-quality scan clean (no filler or AI-pattern flags)
Page types match search intent on all 8 core queries (no page-type mismatch)

findings.title: No named person anywhere on the site
findings.description: About page names nobody; all 25 BlogPosting authors are the Organization; the only personal name is 'Art' inside a 2021 review. Repo docs list this as waiting on the client (H5).
findings.recommendation: Add owner and account executive(s) with photo, role and years to /about-us/; Person nodes (founder/employee) in src/lib/schema.ts; a reviewer line on the 2026 guides.

findings.title: Cost guide does not answer its own question
findings.description: /office-cleaning-cost-toronto-guide/ is titled '2026 Pricing Guide' but every figure is labelled hypothetical and 'not Evergreen quotes'. Competing results (HomeStars $30-60/hr) give numbers.
findings.recommendation: Publish Evergreen's real bands by office size and frequency from recent proposals (needs client decision D-D), or retitle to 'How Office Cleaning Is Priced in Toronto'.

findings.title: All imagery is stock; no case study is published; gallery is 71 words
findings.description: 13 gallery photos are stock with job-like filenames; the one real project (warehouse strip and wax, ~50k sq ft) is a draft held by the photo-approval gate.
findings.recommendation: Run the photoshoot (H6); publish 2-3 case studies via src/content/projects; until then noindex /cleaning-demo-gallery/ or caption it honestly.

findings.title: Trust claims asserted but never evidenced
findings.description: 'WSIB covered, bonded and insured' on 24-25 pages and 'since 1989' on 26, with no certificate, insurer, coverage amount or dated artefact.
findings.recommendation: Add a proof block on /about-us/ and the quote page: 'Certificate of insurance and WSIB clearance available on request', insurer and coverage, screening method.

findings.title: Keyword cannibalisation on 'commercial cleaning Toronto'
findings.description: Homepage, /services/commercial-cleaning/ and /locations/toronto-downtown/ all target it; footer anchors on 60 pages send 'Toronto' to the downtown page and 'Toronto & GTA' to the commercial page; 'Richmond Hill' and 'Scarborough' anchors point at the bare hub.
findings.recommendation: One primary query per URL; in src/data/site.ts footerAreas rename 'Toronto' to 'Downtown Toronto', repoint or remove 'Toronto & GTA', make the two city anchors plain text.

findings.title: Location pages share one heading outline; Mississauga and Vaughan intros switch to generic sales voice
findings.description: 5 of 7 pages open with the same sentence; 'top-tier', 'Zero Disruption', 'Total peace of mind' copy in src/data/locations.ts.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the two intros in the house voice; give each page a unique local opening; vary H2s where content allows.

findings.title: 15 legacy posts untouched since 2019-2023, with unsourced statistics and defects
findings.description: '5 Easy Ways' post says 'our top three tips'; plants, deep-cleaning and slips posts cite 'studies' without sources; 13 posts have no outbound citation.
findings.recommendation: Fix the defects; cite or delete statistics; update or consolidate in priority order (dental, retail, day vs night, deep cleaning, dusting); consider noindexing plants, home-office and fridge posts.

findings.title: Quote form too long for a first price question
findings.description: About 9 required fields including full street address before any price; the SERP persona wanting a ballpark scores 45/100.
findings.recommendation: Make street address optional, keep postal code, add sq ft / visits per week / washrooms, offer a ballpark-by-email path (client decision D-A).

findings.title: Thin utility pages and manufacturer copy
findings.description: /contact-us/ 122 words, /request-a-quote/ 158, /locations/ 229, /green-clean-products/ mostly manufacturer copy with a 2013 news line.
findings.recommendation: Add 'what happens next' and a trust strip to contact and quote pages; rewrite green-clean-products in house words.

findings.title: Persona-matched reviews not shown on the pages that need them
findings.description: Clinic, floor-stripping and post-construction pages show no testimonial; the only property-manager review sits on Mississauga and commercial-cleaning.
findings.recommendation: Tag reviews by service in src/data/reviews.ts and render the matching one per page; date or drop the three undated homepage testimonials.

findings.title: Service pages carry 18-44% shared boilerplate; building-maintenance and floor-stripping overlap
findings.description: Trust band, 'How it works', 'Where we work' repeat verbatim.
findings.recommendation: Shorten 'How it works' to a link to /our-process/ on specialty pages; make building-maintenance the hub and link to floor-stripping for detail.

findings.title: Footer emits five H2s on every page; homepage uses headings as labels
findings.description: Dilutes the heading outline without breaking it.
findings.recommendation:
Change footer titles to styled

; demote homepage label headings.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles and descriptions on every indexable page; one H1 each; no heading skips; zero generic or empty anchors; breadcrumbs on 58/60; skip link on all
Healthy internal linking: no orphans, least-linked post still has 4 inlinks; services, locations, industries and posts cross-link
55 of 60 indexable pages exceed 300 words

findings.title: Money pages do not link to the blog guides; 13 of 25 posts have no in-copy inlink
findings.description: No service, industry or location page links to the cost guide, the 'how often' guide or the seasonal checklist; the two guides do not link to each other; floor-stripping, industrial, post-construction, emergency, pressure-washing, graffiti, property-management and all 8 location pages link to no post. Counting only indexable pages, the floor post, dental checklist and home-office post have 2, 2 and 1 inlinks. Five service-style anchors point at /about-us/ or /services/ instead of the commercial pillar.
findings.recommendation: Apply the 36-link matrix in findings/cluster.md via the related arrays in src/content/services/*.md and the blog front matter; link each service page to its supporting guide and back.

findings.title: Inconsistent title suffix; 22 blog titles carry no brand
findings.description: 22 pages end '| Evergreen', 11 '- Evergreen Office Cleaning', 22 legacy posts have no suffix.
findings.recommendation: One pattern in the layout; add the suffix to bare post titles.

findings.title: Six titles over 60 characters, eight descriptions 161-170 characters
findings.description: Commercial-cleaning title 64 chars is the only likely truncation; 8 descriptions lose their ending.
findings.recommendation: Trim to <=60 / <=155; keep the call to action early.

findings.title: Legacy 'hook' descriptions that say nothing specific
findings.description: e.g. plants post 'Here we discuss...', floors 'Do your floors sparkle?', contact page 'We'd love to hear from you'.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite as answer-first summaries in the blog front matter and contact page.

findings.title: Thin pages
findings.description: Gallery 71 words, contact 122, quote 158, /locations/ 229, /insights/page/3/ 263.
findings.recommendation: Caption the gallery (or noindex it until real photos exist); give the locations hub a paragraph per city.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Coherent JSON-LD graph on all pages: ProfessionalService (#organization) with address, geo, hours, areaServed, sameAs, contactPoint, offer catalog; WebSite; BreadcrumbList valid on 90 pages; Service + WebPage on 19; BlogPosting complete on 25; FAQPage text matches visible text on all 78 Q&As
No parse errors, no duplicate @ids, no deprecated types; aggregateRating correctly omitted (self-serving reviews earn no stars)

findings.title: WebSite SearchAction points at a noindex, JS-only search page
findings.description: Sitelinks search box was retired by Google in Nov 2024; /search/ is noindex and covers blog posts only.
findings.recommendation: Remove potentialAction from the WebSite node in src/lib/schema.ts.

findings.title: logo and image are the same 884x265 banner
findings.description: Google prefers a square-croppable logo and real photos for image.
findings.recommendation: Supply a 512x512 logo for logo and 1-2 real photos as an image array (after the photoshoot).

findings.title: BlogPosting image is 2:1 (960x480) on 23 posts; dates at midnight UTC
findings.description: Google recommends 16:9, 4:3, 1:1; the 1200x630 OG images exist.
findings.recommendation: Pass [ogImage, featureImage] to image in articleSchema(); emit date-only or offset-aware dates.

findings.title: FAQPage markup earns no rich result since May 2026
findings.description: Accurate and harmless; the visible FAQs are the value.
findings.recommendation: Keep the visible FAQs; do not add more FAQPage markup; keeping or removing the JSON-LD is low stakes.

findings.title: Breadcrumb root name differs on two posts ('Home' vs site name); location Service nodes thinner than service-page ones; streetAddress has trailing period
findings.description: Cosmetic consistency issues.
findings.recommendation: Use site.name for the root in the post breadcrumb builder; have the location template call serviceSchema(); drop the period if the Google listing has none.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0 on every mobile run; hero image has dimensions, fetchpriority=high, AVIF/WebP sources, preconnect to the image host; only slide 1 loads eagerly
All CSS inlined (zero render-blocking requests); site JS ~9 KB; reCAPTCHA loaded on form intent only; video widget preload=none
Caching correct: /_astro immutable, images 30d/1y edge, HTML revalidated at the edge; Brotli; HTTP/2 and h3

findings.title: Google tag scripts drive TBT and the lost mobile score
findings.description: Third-party code blocks the main thread for 1,345 ms on the mobile homepage; gtag/js alone has a 962 ms long task. Inner pages still pay ~500 ms. There is exactly one gtm.js and one gtag.js, so no duplicate to remove.
findings.recommendation: Defer the GTM loader to first interaction or idle (~4 s), with immediate triggers on tel: pointerdown and form focus; container hygiene (one Google tag for AW + GA4, prune unused tags). Monitor Ads/GA4 for a week after shipping. Not recommended: Partytown, server-side tagging as a first step.

findings.title: Simulated LCP 6.8 s vs observed 1.5 s on the mobile homepage
findings.description: Lantern models ~330 KB of contending bytes (two 50 KB fonts, logo, hero, gtm.js) at 1.6 Mbps. The hero AVIF is 14.8 KB and loaded in 786 ms.
findings.recommendation: Remove the competing bytes (defer GTM, drop the italic font from the homepage); optional mobile hero preload; re-measure and add real-user monitoring.

findings.title: Italic Open Sans (50 KB) fetched on the homepage for the testimonial <cite> only
findings.description: Requested at VeryHigh priority during the hero download; the only CSS italic rule is for blog blockquotes.
findings.recommendation: Set .tes-name { font-style: normal } and scope the italic @font-face to post pages.

findings.title: INP unmeasured; risk from long third-party tasks and the reCAPTCHA burst on first form touch
findings.description: Eight long tasks up to 962 ms on the homepage trace; ~700 KB of reCAPTCHA scripting loads on first interaction with the quote form.
findings.recommendation: Add web-vitals RUM; consider Turnstile (already supported in the Worker) or earlier idle loading of the captcha near the form.

findings.title: Service-card images oversized; Cloudflare Insights beacon on every page
findings.description: sizes='100vw' for a 380 px card picks the 768 variant (~25-30 KB waste across three cards); beacon.min.js (10 KB) is injected at the edge.
findings.recommendation: Fix sizes and add a 640w variant; switch off Web Analytics auto-inject if GA4 is the system of record.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Every AI crawler is allowed: wildcard plus a named group of 13 bots with Content-Signal search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes; live fetches with 9 AI user agents returned the full page
Content is in the server HTML; llms.txt is present, spec-compliant and accurate; /how-often-should-an-office-be-cleaned/ is citation-ready (direct answer, tables, dated sources, FAQ)
Accessibility 100; landmarks, skip link, labelled navs and fully labelled forms with autocomplete on all pages; estimated Lighthouse agentic fraction 3/3 (unconfirmed, computed by hand)

findings.title: Cost guide gives no real price range
findings.description: AI answers for 'office cleaning cost Toronto' will quote a competitor's range.
findings.recommendation: Publish first-party bands with a 'pricing data last reviewed' date (needs client input).

findings.title: Weak off-site entity; sameAs profiles carry the former name
findings.description: No Wikidata entry; Facebook, LinkedIn and X slugs/names say 'Evergreen Cleaning Service'; no YouTube; no citations found under the new NAP.
findings.recommendation: Rename the social display names with a 'formerly' line; claim Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, YellowPages, BBB, Board of Trade, BIA, BSCAI/ISSA listings under the new name.

findings.title: reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox blocks any agent-completed quote request
findings.description: Required hidden field stays invalid until the checkbox is solved; the Worker rejects unverified tokens; the honeypot returns a fake {ok:true} to a naive agent.
findings.recommendation: Document the email/phone fallback on the quote page and in llms.txt now; evaluate Turnstile (provider already supported); later a verified-agent path.

findings.title: No definitional first sentence on the homepage; service definitions sit under the wrong or second heading
findings.description: Homepage never says 'Evergreen Office Cleaning is...'; office-cleaning definition is under 'Who it is for'; Trustindex boilerplate repeated 7 times in extracted text.
findings.recommendation: Add one definitional sentence in the hero; rename the fitHeading to 'What is office cleaning?'; move the commercial-cleaning definition first; render the Trustindex note once.

findings.title: llms.txt omits the three 2026 guides and states the 2-hour reply without the office-hours qualifier
findings.description: Served without charset.
findings.recommendation: Add a ## Guides section, qualify the reply promise everywhere, serve text/plain; charset=utf-8.

findings.title: Few first-party facts; stock imagery; no topical video
findings.description: Nothing countable beyond 'since 1989'.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 dated company facts to /about-us/ and llms.txt; real photos after the shoot; 2-3 short YouTube clips with VideoObject.

findings.title: Seven identical 'Read more' buttons; empty corner <th> in the commercial-cleaning table
findings.description: Ambiguous names for agents listing controls.
findings.recommendation: Review-specific accessible names; give the corner cell text and add a caption.

findings.title: Bing/IndexNow plumbing not confirmed; no llms-full.txt or Markdown alternates
findings.description: Optional for a Google-focused local site.
findings.recommendation: Verify Bing Webmaster Tools, submit the sitemap; optionally generate /llms-full.txt at build time.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0 of 233 images missing alt; descriptive alt text and file names; AVIF/WebP via <picture> with srcset/sizes; dimensions on 220/233; lazy loading below the fold; dedicated image host with 30d/1y caching; og:image on every page

findings.title: Gallery serves 13 full-size JPGs (~1.1 MB) with no responsive variants or dimensions
findings.description: The only 13 images without width/height; 37-126 KB each.
findings.recommendation: Run them through the existing AVIF/WebP pipeline with dimensions and captions.

findings.title: Blog archive thumbnails are 300x150 JPG crops stretched to 382 px
findings.description: Visibly soft on /insights/ and in related-post cards (32 occurrences).
findings.recommendation: Generate 480-768 px AVIF/WebP variants with srcset; drop the WordPress crop names.

findings.title: Mobile hero images are 640 px wide (1.55x on a Pixel 7); service-card sizes hint overstated
findings.description: Slightly soft hero under the overlay; ~25-30 KB waste on three cards.
findings.recommendation: Add an 828/960w hero variant; fix the card sizes and add a 640w variant.

findings.title: Shared OG image on 20 pages; logo has a non-transparent background
findings.description: Most service and location pages share one generic social image; the header logo shows a pale box.
findings.recommendation: Per-service OG images; re-export the logo as transparent SVG/PNG.

local_seo.note: Not in the weighted health score; see findings/local.md

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Defer GTM to first interaction/idle with tel: and form-focus triggers; agree the measurement trade-off with the Ads owner and watch conversions for a week
Drop the italic font from the homepage; fix service-card sizes; switch off the Cloudflare beacon if unused
Fix sitewide footer anchors (Toronto -> Downtown Toronto; repoint 'Toronto & GTA'; Richmond Hill and Scarborough as plain text)
Retitle the cost guide or get real price bands from the client (decision D-D)
Fix /privacy/ http link; add charset to Content-Type; remove the WebSite SearchAction; drop the trailing period in the street address
Enforce the non-script CSP directives

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Named people: owner and account executive on /about-us/ with photos, Person schema, reviewer line on the 2026 guides (client input)
Proof block: certificate of insurance and WSIB clearance on request, insurer and coverage, screening method; link ECOLOGO listing

Review programme: weekly review requests via the approved kit; show the true Google count/rating as visible text; persona-matched reviews on clinic, floor, post-construction and property-management pages
Citations under the new name: Google Business Profile check, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, YellowPages.ca, Yelp, HomeStars, BBB, Clutch; rename Facebook/LinkedIn/X display names
Quote form: street address optional, add sq ft / visits per week / washrooms; document the email/phone fallback for assistants; evaluate Turnstile

Title suffix pattern for all pages; trim long titles/descriptions; rewrite legacy hook descriptions; add charset and the 2026 guides to llms.txt; definitional sentences on the homepage and service pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Photoshoot (H6) and 2-3 case studies through the existing /projects/ gate; replace stock gallery or noindex it until then
Floor stripping and waxing page: $/sq ft bands, before/after, annual lobby cycle (weakest competing SERP)
Rewrite Mississauga and Vaughan intros in the house voice; unique local openings per location page; add trust ticks to the location hero
Legacy blog pass: fix defects, cite or delete statistics, update or merge the 15 untouched posts, consider noindexing the off-core posts; monthly commercial-topic cadence (see findings/cluster.md)
Clinic page: state IPAC training, colour-coding and logs; add a clinic testimonial; post-construction page targeted at commercial/contractor intent
Local links: BIA directory, BSCAI/ISSA, Toronto Region Board of Trade and city chambers; property-manager vendor pages
Gallery and related-card images through the AVIF pipeline; per-service OG images; square logo for schema

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Add web-vitals RUM (or enable CrUX via PSI once quota allows) to get field LCP/INP/CLS; re-run Lighthouse 3-5 times per page after the GTM change
Search Console: watch the 'commercial cleaning Toronto' query distribution across the three URLs after the anchor fix; track impressions by city before building North York/Scarborough pages
Check Cloudflare AI Crawl Control allows verified AI bots; verify Bing Webmaster Tools and submit the sitemap
Exclude shared templates from sitemap lastmod; CI check for lastmod presence; spot-check the first Worker-published live post
Decide on Content-Signal lines (Lighthouse SEO 92) and FAQPage JSON-LD; switch CSP to enforcing after two clean weeks
Quarterly: re-audit, drift baseline once the plugin can fetch through the proxy

artifacts.raw_dir: raw/ (crawl index, sitemaps, robots, llms.txt; large HTML and Lighthouse JSON kept locally only)
